name: termq-dev
description: Development harness for the TermQ project — Gitflow workflow with Swift/SwiftUI language support.

code-review.prompt: Review this code for correctness, Swift 6 concurrency safety, and consistency with TermQ's surrounding patterns. Check for unhandled errors, memory leaks, and missing tests. Flag anything that would not survive a strict Swift 6 audit.

security-audit.prompt: Audit this code for security issues: unsafe data handling, missing input validation, insecure IPC or MCP surface, logging of sensitive terminal output, and capability over-exposure. Treat all terminal content as user data — never log it.

refactor.prompt: Identify refactoring opportunities in this code: repeated logic that could be extracted, SwiftUI views that are doing too much and should push state into a ViewModel or service, and abstractions that are premature or missing. Suggest concrete changes, not general principles.

pr-summary.prompt: Summarise what this PR does, why it is needed, and what the key design decisions were. Keep it to two short paragraphs — the first suitable for a CHANGELOG entry, the second for the PR description body.

changelog.prompt: Write a CHANGELOG entry for this change. Format: a single bullet point starting with the type tag (feat / fix / refactor / chore) followed by a concise description of what changed and why it matters to users or developers. No more than two sentences.
